container.name: notifications
container.query: SELECT c.id, c.eagleId, c.name, c.name AS nameTokens, c.description, c.proponent, c.nature, c.location, c.trigger, c.region, c.type, c.subType, c.decision, c.pcp, c.notificationReceivedDate, c.decisionDate, c.isPublished, c.read, c._ts FROM c WHERE c._ts >= @HighWaterMark ORDER BY c._ts
